17_smart_money_timing.name: Smart-money timing chain (which graded wallets entered early, which way)
17_smart_money_timing.description: Layer 4 · for each market with >=4 distinct entrants, ranks wallets by entry time, marks the early window (first third), and records which GRADED wallets entered early + the size-weighted direction they took. The early-DIRECTION call is committed to a sha256-chained issue-on-change log BEFORE the market resolves (forward-witness). Entry-order is observable from public trades; our timed early-direction call cannot be backfilled into the chain. PROVISIONAL gate: forward-witnessed accuracy must reach >=55% on n>=50 resolved-after-issue markets before any accuracy claim is marketed (the retroactive backtest is a diagnostic only · the copyability-v4.0/v60gSS lesson).
